item.title: v0.8.140
item.description:
HyperFrames v0.8.140

Released on 2026-10-07.

Motion blur now works over video, and rendering reports encoding and assembly progress. Studio previews, image replacement, and long-timeline zoom are more reliable.

Changes

  • Composition hosts can show the hover outline and set the stage’s starting size. (#5116).
  • Replacing an image fill now changes the displayed picture. (#5170).
  • Rebound root timelines keep advancing with the playback clock. (#5165).
  • Slow documents wait for their own frame cadence before capture. (#5168).
  • Fresh timeline updates from a host are preserved. (#5159).
  • Transcription keeps words spoken before the detected speech onset. (#5164).
  • Zooming long timelines does less image decoding and drawing. (#5142).
  • The preview catches up after missed file changes. (#5126).
  • Music requests use the host app’s music tools, with a clear error when the required CLI is missing. (#5154).
  • Feedback can report missing features and host-app friction without a rating. (#5140).
  • Automatic render worker counts respect the available memory budget. (#5149).
  • CLI startup loads reporting code without loading the full rendering engine, and history tests no longer race. (#5153).
  • Motion blur renders correctly over video by keeping the video frame steady across samples. (#5150).
  • Checks avoid false static-motion and text-overlap warnings on valid compositions. (#5147).
  • Imported scenes stay within their source time ranges. (#5132).
  • Rendering shows progress while encoding and assembling the output. (#5137).
  • Imported film HTML can use native capture while preserving its structure. (#5131).
  • Catalog previews run block scripts inline, and six shader blocks have dedicated documentation pages. (#5139).
  • The catalog adds six WebGPU shader backgrounds. (#5138).
  • Asynchronous frame sources can render repeatable frames. (#5130).
  • Skill publishing verifies that the latest creative guidance is available. (#5081).
  • WebGPU compositions can render with software graphics through an opt-in setting. (#5133).
  • Producer unit tests run without reaching the network. (#5135).
  • Timeline zoom stays smoother on long projects. (#5109).
  • Browser tests use a consistent launch path and a bounded time budget. (#5134).
  • The preview preloads upcoming scene images, and checks handle image swaps correctly. (#5128).

Performance

  • Studio: Parse saved HTML once when syncing timeline length (e8cfd6b73, #5092).

  • Registry: Gooey split block with metaball goo and directional motion blur (b50dead1d, #5123).

  • Studio: Dragging a Layers row no longer highlights the row names (8b5b012e5, #5104).
  • CLI: Use a healthy pinned Sherpa copy beside the CLI (f6e419eb2, #5095).

Internal

  • Studio: Bundle the real-Chrome undo test with esbuild so its setup fits on Windows (b9998dd5a, #5080).
  • Producer: Compiler parity test runs without the network (f80614cde, #5087).
  • Studio: Keep the undo socket gate's sockets pinned past Chrome's idle media suspend (43d07781d, #5108).
  • Remove committed design notes and ignore docs/contracts (6308727b8, #5107).

item.description:
HyperFrames v0.8.135

Released on 2026-10-05.

Studio edits preserve animation easing and Undo restores the latest edit, while Layers icons and nested scenes behave more predictably. Catalog previews now load under the docs site's script policy, with safer script encoding.

Fixes

  • Studio: Keyframed animations keep their ease through every Studio edit (0d5e395cd3, #5051).
  • Studio: Undo takes back the last edit, even right after a resize or a nudge (98fe011699, #5048).
  • Studio: Layers rows show a kind icon, and only a group row has a caret (f7d6734761, #5067).
  • Engine: A render fails when a composition's own script throws before its timeline binds (39a693c0a4, #5033).
  • Core: A sub-composition follows its host clip when the host moves without a reload (5d19e23cb4, #5058).

Docs & Examples

  • Skills: Teach shared cut constants and fill lights for Three.js scenes (6c353d89c8, #5077).

Catalog

  • Catalog: Encode module aliases before constructing script code (1d9b3673fa, #5093).
  • Catalog: 3D previews load their scripts under the docs host's script policy (f835f83164, #5090).

Internal

  • Pin the guards that keep script-placed scenes and unparseable scripts out of the in-place move (3c40f37938, #5079).

Released on 2026-10-02.

Manual editing in Studio is far more reliable: resizes, crops and drops survive undo and reload, and undo works right after an edit or during a drag. Apps that embed Studio can also run its agent tools on their own edit session, and a video's sound now stays on its clip by default.

Features

  • Keep a video's sound on the clip by default (1/8) (37f30b1d06c, #4813).
  • Studio: Hosts can run Studio's agent tools on their own edit session (7a60b97bf8c, #4882).

Fixes

  • Studio: A failed prepared-content write is a failed commit, not saved (396f2fbf808).
  • Studio: Persist honors prepareContent again so audio edits keep their content step (76c4fc7b3cf).
  • Studio: Edits on GSAP-animated layers keep their keyframes and file positions (d4756f597c0, #4869).
  • Studio: Undo right after an edit undoes that edit, even before its save lands (c3b6e55f7eb, #4807).
  • Studio: The timeline scroll gate catches dropped frames in the virtualized view (21a29c2ac74, #4855).
  • Studio: A focused video or audio player keeps its arrow and play keys (a59d93a027a, #4854).
  • Scripts: Count comments after regex literals in the comment ratchet (fd105807c49, #4879).
  • Studio: An undo that lands mid-drag keeps the box under the pointer (83035e08b81, #4853).
  • Studio: A reload requested while a canvas save is in flight loads again once it lands (d05344b3eed, #4874).
  • Studio: A first animation in a sub-composition file runs from inside its template (30c55694cb9, #4806).
  • Core: A composition made only of a set shows it at a seek in the preview (78e849235aa, #4865).
  • A save's temp file no longer reaches Studio as an outside change (c72b735a8c4, #4857).

Internal

  • Studio: Trim comments to the ratchet (2d690968ccb).
